critique: The render reads as an ethereal, pastel-blue particle plane: a dense luminous horizontal band, soft bloom, black negative space, and slight flowing deformation between t1 and t4 all support the preset intent. However, very large out-of-focus circular particles dominate the foreground and frame edges, especially at t4, making the result feel more like bokeh flying past the camera than a refined magical plane. The particle band is also somewhat unevenly cluttered beneath the main horizon.

suggestions.why: Reduce the maximum particle size so the oversized foreground discs no longer overpower the delicate plane.
Lower size randomness to retain depth variation while making the particle field more controlled and thumbnail-like.
